summary: Added explicit chat, raw text completion, exact token-ID completion, and typed fill-in-middle request semantics.
Implemented raw completion without chat-template rendering, stable batch input indexes, monotonic per-input events, and independent cancellation.
Extracted an owned product-neutral llama-native-host for resident slots, memory budgeting, lifecycle, cancellation, stream tickets, and injected cache dependencies.
Migrated Mom Llama resident model management onto llama-native-host and proved repeated acquisition reuses one worker.
Added path-independent inspected model descriptors and prompt-mode/token-policy cache fingerprints.
Kept fill-in-middle unavailable because the loaded model does not expose a verified prefix/suffix/middle token contract; unsupported_prompt_form is returned instead of advertising fake support.

tests_run.command: cargo test -p mom-llama-app && cargo clippy -p mom-llama-app --all-targets -- -D warnings
MOM_LLAMA_MODEL_PATH=<local SmolLM2 GGUF> cargo test -p llama-native-engine real_completion_text_tokens_batch_and_capabilities -- --ignored
tests_run.detail: Proved exact source hashing, direct token-ID consumption, two-input raw completion, monotonic stream indexes, selective branch cancellation, truthful descriptor capabilities, and typed FIM refusal.

tests_run.detail: Inference and host crates contain no network or process authority; 81 commands, 90 affordances, 25 effects, 36 parity rows, 58 settings, zero blockers.

deferred.reason: No verified model-specific FIM token contract is exposed by the pinned binding/model inspection path.
The pinned safe llama-cpp binding always parses special-token text; only the two tested parse-special BOS policies are advertised.
Library-first linking is sufficient; a future crash-isolation adapter belongs in a separate crate and must preserve the same DTOs.
